text: I think you'll love Sweetslady's Chocolate Peanut Butter Brownie Trifle! It features brown sugar, which we know is a favorite of yours, and combines it with rich chocolate and peanut butter flavors. The recipe also includes a variety of textures, from the cream cheese and peanut butter to the crunchy peanut butter cups. Given that you tend to enjoy recipes with a moderate cooking time of around 45 minutes, this one might be a bit longer, but the end result is likely to be well worth the extra 15 minutes.
